experiment: P3c MFT sparse-delay deconvolution count oracle
research_question: Is MFT num_targets physically identifiable from the exact MFT component by deconvolving the known transmit reference into a sparse delay impulse train?

parameter_contract.valid_mask: label[MFT]=1 AND parameter_mask[28]=1 AND finite num_targets

estimator.reference: 10 MHz, 100 us LFM, chirp rate 5e10 Hz/s, zero padded to 3000 samples
estimator.count: number of above-threshold delay bins, clipped to [0,8]

controls.C0_constant: 5.5 targets, fixed midpoint of original 3-8 support
controls.C2_raw_correct_reference: same method on compound IQ, diagnostic only

next_if_pass: Freeze the inverse-filter front end and test raw/separated count estimation on a new identity seed with an ordinal or support-denoising head.
